name: locn
statement: locn = UNKNOWNpt | EOFpt | POSN num num

name: locnrow_def
statement: locnrow (POSN r c) = r

name: locn_rowupdate_def
statement: locn_rowupdate f (POSN r c) = POSN (f r) c

name: locncol_def
statement: locncol (POSN r c) = c

name: locn_colupdate_def
statement: locn_colupdate f (POSN r c) = POSN r (f c)

name: locs
statement: locs = Locs locn locn

name: default_loc_def
statement: default_loc = POSN 0 0

name: start_locs_def
statement: start_locs = Locs default_loc default_loc

name: unknown_loc_def
statement: unknown_loc = Locs UNKNOWNpt UNKNOWNpt

name: locnle_def
statement:
locnle l1 l2 <=>
    l1 = l2 ∨ (* reflexivity, for free *)
    l1 = UNKNOWNpt ∨ (* minimal element *)
    l2 = EOFpt ∨ (* maximal element *)
    (* otherwise compare row and col lexicographically*)
    l2 ≠ UNKNOWNpt ∧ l1 ≠ EOFpt ∧
    (l1.row < l2.row ∨ l1.row = l2.row ∧ l1.col < l2.col)

name: locnle_REFL
statement: locnle l l

name: locnle_total
statement: locnle l1 l2 ∨ locnle l2 l1

name: locnle_ANTISYM
statement: locnle l1 l2 ∧ locnle l2 l1 ⇒ l1 = l2

name: locnle_TRANS
statement: locnle l1 l2 ∧ locnle l2 l3 ⇒ locnle l1 l3

name: locnle_end
statement: locnle EOFpt l ⇔ l = EOFpt

name: locnle_unknown
statement: locnle l UNKNOWNpt ⇔ l = UNKNOWNpt

name: locsle_def
statement: locsle (Locs l1 _) (Locs l2 _) ⇔ locnle l1 l2

name: locsle_REFL
statement: locsle l l

name: locsle_total
statement: locsle l1 l2 ∨ locsle l2 l1

name: locsle_TRANS
statement: locsle l1 l2 ∧ locsle l2 l3 ⇒ locsle l1 l3

name: merge_locs_def
statement: merge_locs (Locs l1 l2) (Locs l3 l4) = Locs l1 l4

name: merge_list_locs_def
statement:
(merge_list_locs [] = unknown_loc) /\
  (merge_list_locs (h :: []) = h) /\
  (merge_list_locs (h1 :: h2 :: []) = merge_locs h1 h2) /\
  (merge_list_locs (h1 :: h2 :: t) = merge_list_locs (h1 :: t))

name: map_loc_def
statement:
(map_loc [] _ = []) /\
  (map_loc (h :: t) n =
    (h, Locs (POSN 0 n) (POSN 0 n)) :: map_loc t (n+1))

name: merge_locs_assoc
statement:
(merge_locs (merge_locs l1 l2) l3 = merge_locs l1 l3) ∧
  (merge_locs l1 (merge_locs l2 l3) = merge_locs l1 l3)

name: merge_list_locs_2
statement:
∀h1 h2 t.
    merge_list_locs (h1 :: h2 :: t) = merge_list_locs (merge_locs h1 h2 :: t)

name: merge_list_locs_nested
statement:
∀h t1 t2. merge_list_locs (merge_list_locs (h::t1) :: t2) =
            merge_list_locs (h :: t1 ++ t2)

name: merge_list_locs_sing
statement: merge_list_locs [h] = h

name: merge_locs_idem
statement: merge_locs l l = l
